data.name: Aladdin
data.gender_notes: Aladdin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aladdin (Alauddin) is an Arabic name meaning 'nobility of the religion' or 'excellence of faith'. It is derived from 'Ala' (علاء) meaning elevation or nobility, and 'Din' (دين) meaning religion. It was used by many historical Muslim rulers and scholars. The name Aladdin carries the meaning “Nobility of the Faith” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Aladdin usually hope their child will grow to embody nobility of the faith and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aladdin reflects one who upholds the honor of faith, living with strong values, wisdom, and noble actions.
data.etymology: Aladdin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Nobility of the Faith.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aladdin total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: العدين
in_arabic.meaning: العدين يعني الشخص الذي يعتز بكرامة الإسلام و يحافظ عليها
in_arabic.long_meaning: العدين هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'ع د ن' والذي يحمل معاني مثل 'الخدمة' أو 'العبادة'. في السياق الإسلامي، يمكن أن يعني الاسم الشخص الذي يكرس نفسه لخدمة الله و المجتمع، مع الحفاظ على كرامة الإسلام و مبادئه الأساسية.

in_urdu.name: العدین
in_urdu.meaning: العدین کا مطلب ہے جو شخص اسلام کی عزت کرتا ہے اور اس کا احترام کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: العدین عربی جڑ 'ع د ن' سے ماخوذ ہے جس کے معنی ہیں 'خدمت' یا 'عبادت'. اسلامی تناظر میں، اس نام کا مطلب ہو سکتا ہے وہ شخص جو خود کو اللہ کی خدمت اور معاشرے کے لئے وقف کرتا ہے، جبکہ اسلام کی کرامت اور بنیادی اصولوں کو برقرار رکھتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان روایت میں، یہ نام روحانی سلوک اور اسلامی اقدار کے ساتھ وابستہ ہے.

in_hindi.name: अलादीन
in_hindi.meaning: अलादीन का अर्थ है जो व्यक्ति इस्लाम का सम्मान करता है और उसकी इज़्ज़त करता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: अलादीन अरबी मूल 'ع د ن' से लिया गया है जिसका अर्थ है 'सेवा' या 'पूजा'. इस्लामी संदर्भ में, इस नाम का अर्थ हो सकता है वह व्यक्ति जो खुद को अल्लाह की सेवा और समाज के लिए समर्पित करता है, जबकि इस्लाम की गरिमा और मूल सिद्धांतों को बनाए रखता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम आध्यात्मिक आचरण और इस्लामी मूल्यों से जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: العدين
in_pashto.meaning: العدين معنی یې دا دی چې کوم کس د اسلام عزت کوي او احترام یې کوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: العدين د عربی جڑ 'ع د ن' څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې معنی یې دي 'خدمت' یا 'عبادت'. په اسلامي سياق کې، دا نوم معنی لري هغه څوک چې خپل ځان د الله خدمت او ټولنې لپاره وقف کوي، پداسې حال کې چې د اسلام کرامت او بنسټيزو اصولو ته پام کوي. د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ارزښو په منځ کې، دا نوم د روحاني چلند او اسلامي ارزښو سره تړاو لري.

in_english.name: Aladdin
in_english.meaning: Aladdin means a person who honors and respects Islam
in_english.long_meaning: Aladdin is derived from the Arabic root 'ع د ن' which carries meanings such as 'service' or 'worship'. In an Islamic context, the name may signify a person who dedicates himself to serving God and society, while maintaining the dignity and fundamental principles of Islam. Historically and spiritually, the name Aladdin is associated with devotion, piety, and a strong connection to Islamic values and traditions.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aladdin became popularised in Western culture through the tales entitled "One Thousand and One Nights", where Aladdin is a main character. These tales have influenced many aspects of media, especially entertainment, throughout the 20th and 21st centuries. The persona of Aladdin as a brave and resourceful young man inspires many children and adults alike.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Aladdin represents an individual who strives for excellence in their faith, aiming for moral elevation and spiritual enlightenment. It is a reminder of the importance of enhancing one's connection to God through piety and good deeds. By carrying this name, one is encouraged to strive for nobility in both their actions and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aladdin's name is derived from the Arabic words "al-'ad-din," meaning "the right religion." This name symbolizes a deep commitment to following the true path of Islam and living a virtuous life. The character Aladdin in folklore is known for his wisdom, courage, and kindness, embodying the ideal Muslim character.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Aladdin is a character from The Thousand and One Nights, also known as The Arabian Nights, a collection of Middle Eastern folk tales compiled in Arabic during the Islamic Golden Age.
historical_references.context: Aladdin is a young man who is tricked by a sorcerer into entering a magical lamp, which contains a genie. The genie grants Aladdin three wishes, and he uses them to gain wealth and power.

trends: popular in children's stories and media
platforms: books, movies, TV shows, video games
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aladdin remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
